verdict.rationale: Cactus provides the building blocks for offline document chat but no evidence of an automatic RAG feature. It runs models fully on-device with no data leaving the device, exposes OpenAI-compatible text APIs, and returns sentence vectors so an app can 'search, match and route locally'. A hands-on user also ran its offline chat app. Missing for 10: automatic retrieval-augmented generation, document ingestion/indexing, a ready-made chat-with-your-documents workflow, and hands-on corroboration of document Q&A offline.
